_table_naming_note: Left null deliberately, so the table name follows the filename: file20260926.csv lands in ef_csv_file20260926 and tomorrow's drop creates its own table. Set an override here to funnel every drop into one accumulating table instead.
_table_schema_note: Source columns from source_config.json followed by ingestion metadata. Checked against the DataFrame before every write, so the two config files cannot drift apart unnoticed.
_write_mode_note: Append, so re-running on the same day adds a second batch to that day's table rather than replacing it. Distinguish batches via _batch_id; switch to overwrite if a re-run should replace the day instead.
